note: 6Li broad s-wave resonances. a(B) of each channel is the coupled-channel table of Zürn et al., PRL 110, 135301 (2013) (Li_feshbach_table.json, 0-2000 G); the B0, Delta, a_bg below are their local fits near each pole (Table 2), used for the resonance table, s_res and the molecule estimates. The local fits do not reproduce the zero crossings; the table does. Channels |12>, |13>, |23> are pairs among the three lowest Zeeman states. The narrow |12> resonance at 543.3 G is sampled too coarsely by the 1 G table; it is divided out of the table and put back analytically (B0 = 543.286 G, Delta = 0.1 G).
a_bg_ref: Zürn et al., PRL 110, 135301 (2013); a_bg for |12> from Table 2 Present fit (−1582 a0). Each resonance carries its own a_bg_a0.
